title: Does anyone else have to go underwater or hold your breath inside a dream to 'travel' to the mall world?
content: I had my first memorable mall dream as a teenager, which on its surface makes sense because I did hang out at the mall a lot. But this particular dream, a sort of 'spirit guide' came to me and taught me a method of travel where (within the dream) I had to go underwater and hold my breath until I couldn't anymore, and then I would come to in another dimension. In the very first one, I 'went under' in a pond and 'came to' in a mall fountain - the kind you throw pennies in to make a wish. In this other dimension I 'reconnected' with a bunch of people I felt close kinship with, but had no obvious analog to my waking life. This has been a recurring dream theme for me, that the mechanism of interdimensional dream travel requires holding my breath until one reality starts to flicker and another emerges. Its never been clear whether I'm actually holding my breath or just dreaming that I'm holding my breath. At times I've suspected its a form of sleep apnea. I've never met anyone else with this experience so I'm curious if anyone here has. Or perhaps even another recurring method of dream travel that takes you back to a place you've been before.
